name: manual_34a8f3
claim: Do not invent ad-hoc token ledgers or UUIDv4 schemes for model launches: map execution escalations to Phylax P5 approval intents and consume them atomically in SqliteP5ApprovalStore under BEGIN IMMEDIATE.

decisions.notes: Phylax P5 already provides durable single-use domain-separated approval consumption with a 300s receipt window; creating parallel process-local ledgers or JTI schemas duplicates existing machinery.

rationale: Phylax P5 already provides durable single-use domain-separated approval consumption with a 300s receipt window; creating parallel process-local ledgers or JTI schemas duplicates existing machinery.
